correctness.rationale: Over algebraically closed characteristic 2 with n>=11, n≡3 (mod 8), all gradient coordinates vanish only when each coordinate solves the same monic cubic x_i^3+e_1 x_i^2+e_2 x_i+e_3=0. The binomial translation coefficients for e4 vanish under n≡3 mod8, legitimate on affine cone representatives. Three distinct values force the three multiplicities ≡1 mod8 by successive e1/e2/e4 comparison; with exactly two, the binomial conditions yield multiplicity a≡1 or 2 mod8, always refinable to three 1-mod8 blocks. The all-equal point lies on all planes; conversely generating series makes e4 and gradient vanish on each plane. Generic Hessian is alternating block diagonal with rank sum(m_i−1)=n−3, and the full singular support has dimension 2, giving normality by R1+S2. Exact independent GF(4) enumeration evaluated every four-value multiplicity pattern at n=11 (364) and n=19 (1540), corroborating the characterization. Multinomial arithmetic verified 55 and 462061, and pair incidences follow two-index intersection. Enumeration is not substituted for the algebraically closed all-n proof.
